lines.text: What if Earth spun faster, and couldn't stop?
lines.phonemes: wˌʌt ɪf ˈɜːθ spˈʌn fˈæstɚ, ænd kˌʊdənt stˈɑːp?

lines.text: And the spin has only just begun to speed up.
lines.phonemes: ænd ðə spˈɪn hɐz ˈoʊnli dʒˈʌst bɪɡˈʌn tə spˈiːd ˈʌp.

lines.text: The day is shrinking fast.
lines.phonemes: ðə dˈeɪ ɪz ʃɹˈɪŋkɪŋ fˈæst.

lines.text: And then the wind starts to blow.
lines.phonemes: ænd ðˈɛn ðə wˈɪnd stˈɑːɹts tə blˈoʊ.

lines.text: The air can't keep up with the ground.
lines.phonemes: ðɪ ˈɛɹ kˈænt kˈiːp ˌʌp wɪððə ɡɹˈaʊnd.

lines.text: And then the oceans start to move.
lines.phonemes: ænd ðˈɛn ðɪ ˈoʊʃənz stˈɑːɹt tə mˈuːv.

lines.text: The oceans are sliding toward the equator.
lines.phonemes: ðɪ ˈoʊʃənz ɑːɹ slˈaɪdɪŋ təwˈɔːɹd ðɪ ɪkwˈeɪɾɚ.

lines.text: And the weather is about to change completely.
lines.phonemes: ænd ðə wˈɛðɚɹ ɪz ɐbˌaʊt tə tʃˈeɪndʒ kəmplˈiːtli.

lines.text: Storms are turning faster, and the days are six hours long.
lines.phonemes: stˈɔːɹmz ɑːɹ tˈɜːnɪŋ fˈæstɚ, ænd ðə dˈeɪz ɑːɹ sˈɪks ˈaʊɚz lˈɔŋ.

lines.text: And the calendar is about to break.
lines.phonemes: ænd ðə kˈæləndɚɹ ɪz ɐbˌaʊt tə bɹˈeɪk.

lines.text: Now a year has more than a thousand days in it.
lines.phonemes: nˈaʊ ɐ jˈɪɹ hɐz mˈɔːɹ ðˌænə θˈaʊzənd dˈeɪz ɪn ɪt.

lines.text: And the days keep getting shorter.
lines.phonemes: ænd ðə dˈeɪz kˈiːp ɡˌɛɾɪŋ ʃˈɔːɹɾɚ.

lines.text: Three hours, then two: a day is as long as a movie.
lines.phonemes: θɹˈiː ˈaʊɚz, ðˈɛn tˈuː: ɐ dˈeɪ ɪz æz lˈɔŋ æz ɐ mˈuːvi.

lines.text: And at an hour and a half, you are almost weightless.
lines.phonemes: ænd æɾ ɐn ˈaʊɚ ænd ɐ hˈæf, juː ɑːɹ ˈɔːlmoʊst wˈeɪtləs.

lines.text: A day now lasts about an hour and a half.
lines.phonemes: ɐ dˈeɪ nˈaʊ lˈæsts ɐbˌaʊt ɐn ˈaʊɚ ænd ɐ hˈæf.

lines.text: One more nudge, and something changes completely.
